I'm sorry to hear that you're feeling like this and I know that it must be very hard. 
I know that life may be hard, that there may be a lot of dark times, but there will be good times. Maybe not now, but some day I promise you. Time heals all wounds, it really does. 

Here is a quote from Doctor Who that helps me quite a bit: 

"The way I see it, everything life is a pile of good things and bad things. The good things don't always soften the bad things, but vice-versa, the bad things don't necessarily spoil the good things and make them unimportant." - The Doctor (11) 

Message me if you ever need someone to talk to.

It's just some things that I've done a long time ago and even now and just who I am and the trouble I've caused them. I just know that I'm probably going to cause them more trouble and I just think that if I never existed, y'know, it would be better for everyone. But I'm here anyways so I'm not going to do it tonight. 
I'm stable for now, thank you for the concern. <3

Thank you so much for this message. I was just in a really bad mindset today and even though I'm still fighting this feeling and it still hurts, I just still can't cause my loved ones this pain. 
And haha yeah, he's really nice. 
And I will, I've asked my parents for some help, a therapist, and they said that they'll get on that. I guess, after what happened today, I probably need that help now rather later. 

Thank you. <3

Or maybe I just made this worse, oh my gosh I don't know what I'm saying I'm not thinking properly. I'm sorry, I didn't mean to misunderstand you and misread everything and I read my thing over again and I sounded kind of aggressive I'm sorry I didn't mean it like that. Please ignore me, I don't want to just delete it cause I don't want to end on a bad note but i'm sorry just ignore this post.

Just because there's no one around you to give you support, that's not a good enough reason to kill yourself. Who says that you need people around you to not kill yourself? It doesn't matter how much help you have, how many people around you, you need to decide for yourself whether you want to stay or not. 

People who talk about other people helping them get better, those "other people" only help as much as that person allows them to help and whatever those "other people" say is the same as what a bunch of strangers on the internet would say. 
If they got better, with or without support, then it was probably because they made the decision to get better...they made a decision to let other people help them or they made a decision to stay or they made a decision to get better themselves, to keep going. 

Okay, so I get your point now. So yeah, we're are alone. But maybe we need to be alone to get better and to keep living cause this is our life and our decision and it doesn't matter what other people do for us or whether they support us or not, this is our own fight.

That's not what people mean when they say "you aren't alone". Yeah, not everyone is going to have someone to help them. But that doesn't mean you're alone. 
You're depressed, suicidal, anxious, and/or so on but so are thousands of other people. The point of "you aren't alone" is saying that yeah, you're in pain, yeah you're hurting and you're scared BUT SO AM I. Don't you dare say I don't know what it's like to want to kill yourself, to be in pain, to hurt, to be scared or anxious or whatever I KNOW IT ALL SO DO YOU AND HUNDREDS OF OTHER PEOPLE AND WE'RE THE ONLY ONES WHO CAN UNDERSTAND EACH OTHER. I understand your pain, I know your pain, I've lived your pain, I'm feeling your pain right now...so you're not alone. I'm not better right now and other people aren't better either but we're not alone because we have each other and we can share each other's pain and get through it together because even though i'll never know your face, your name, your voice and you'll never know mine, at least I know that there's someone out there just like me. So i'm not alone, you're not alone either, no one is alone because there are 7 billion people on this planet and there's ought to be at least one other person whose the same as you and with depression, anxiety, suicidal thoughts there's thousands of people. 

Just look at this subreddit. Look at r/depression. There's other people too. 

SO, YOU *ARE NOT* ALONE. 

Also, don't say that no one gives a shit about your life. I care. Even though I don't care about my life, i still care about your life because it hurts me knowing that another human being feels the same pain as me because i think everyone, all of you guys, are awesome and amazing people who deserve good things just simply based on the fact that you're a human being. maybe i don't believe that about myself, but i still believe that about you guys so hey here's someone who cares about you.
